gaps.note: the data sheet calls the cover hinging and no document says on which edge it swings or how it is held; the format has no hinge, so the cover is drawn as one fitted plate that comes off, and the swing is not stated.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close picture of the cover's hinge

gaps.note: at 7.22 in deep the part might carry fingers at its rear as well as its front; the data sheet's thumbnail shows its front and top only, so no rear row is modelled and none is ruled out.
gaps.wanted: a picture of the part from behind

gaps.note: the data sheet states no cable capacity and no fill ratio, so none is recorded or estimated.
gaps.wanted: a fill table for the BHH managers

gaps.note: the data sheet says the managers help "maintain proper bend radius" and gives no figure, so none is recorded.
gaps.wanted: the bend radius the fingers and cover maintain

gaps.note: no document gives the mounting holes' count or positions, or the ears' width.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the back plate
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, the colour, the finish, the mounting hardware and "Indoor" are the data sheet's table.

bottom.note: estimated - the thumbnails show the same fingers along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - none is stated. The data sheet's overview says only that the managers "help to maintain proper bend radius"; it gives no bend radius, no cable capacity and no fill ratio, so none is recorded and none is estimated.

chassis.note: datasheet - 4U, 7.0 in (177.8 mm) high, 19.0 in wide and 7.22 in (183.4 mm) deep. The width is the 482.6 of 19 in, ears included, as a rack-face part is its ears and what hangs off them. The depth is the maker's overall projection from the rail face, cover and fingers included, and not a body depth. The data sheet's Mount Type is "Rack Mount 19" Horizontal", and its Product Description adds ", 4RU".

color.note: estimated - "Black Powdercoat Finish" and "Color: Black". The thumbnail is a grey CAD render, so the shade is this library's render of black, lightened a little so it reads on a dark stage.

cover.note: datasheet - "Horizontal Manager with Molded Fingers and Hinging Cover, 4RU" (the data sheet's Product Description). The cover is its own part, fitted as shipped, so a drawing can take it off and show the fingers (the `cover-off` configuration). The format has no hinge, so which edge it swings on and its hinge are a gap; no mechanism is invented.

ears.note: estimated - the 16.3 of ear each end is half of the 32.6 between the 450.0 the manager's body is taken to fill (the EIA-310 clear opening between the rails, 17.72 in) and the 482.6 overall. No Belden document gives the ear width or its holes, so the ears are the ends of the back plate and are drawn with it, with no holes.

fingers.note: estimated - MOLDED FINGERS ALONG THE TOP AND THE BOTTOM EDGE OF THE FRONT, EACH A ROW OF ELEVEN WITH TEN OPENINGS. The BHH192UR thumbnail, the clearest of the family, shows the finger rods standing from the back plate to the cover along the top, ten openings counted across; the BHH194UR thumbnail is too small to count again, and its 4U height is carried by the finger plate and the cover, not by more fingers. Its bottom row is read as the top's again. The count, ten, may be out by one. 42.5 pitch, a 34.0 opening and an 8.5 finger, each read as proportions of the 450.0 between the ears; the finger plate is 10.0 thick. THE THUMBNAILS SHOW NO ROW OF FINGERS AT THE REAR of the 7.22 in depth, only the back plate and its flange, so no rear row is modelled: it is not stated either way.

front.note: estimated - the cover, fitted, over the two rows of finger ends. The `duct` guide is the 157.8 between the finger plates (177.8 less 2 x 10.0), over the 450.0 between the ears.

guides.note: estimated - the duct on the front view is the channel between the finger plates, run across the rack; finger pitch 42.5 and opening 34.0 as `fingers`.

left.note: estimated - the side: the back plate, the two finger plates 10.0 high with the channel between, and the cover's face and returns at the front. No picture of the maker's is a side elevation; it is built from the thumbnails and the data sheet's table. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM A DATA SHEET TABLE AND FROM A THUMBNAIL. The BHH194UR technical data sheet (revision 0.47, 05-31-2024) states the rack units, the overall height, width and depth, the weight, the material and the finish, and carries one thumbnail of the part, too small to count a row on. NO BELDEN DOCUMENT HOLDS A DIMENSIONED DRAWING: the manufacturer's product page, the one page the issue found for this part, returned a Cloudflare challenge (403) to the one request made, and the catalog page is a script shell with no content, so the product photographs were not reached. Every figure below that is not the data sheet's table is read off the thumbnails of the BHH192UR and BHH193UR, which are one CAD render in grey and not a photograph, and is `estimated`, with how. Nothing was copied from a thumbnail; the figures are transcribed. The data sheet's footer ("Although Belden makes every reasonable effort ... provided on an AS IS basis") grants no licence to reuse its artwork, so only its figures are used.

mount.note: estimated - the data sheet says the part is a 19 in rack mount with mounting hardware included and shows no figure of how it bolts. Its depth reaches 7.22 in past the rail face, so it is taken as a `rack-face` part that bolts to the rail face at a rack unit and stands out from it, as the Chatsworth Evolution managers are. Whether the line is `rack-face` or `rack` is a choice the pull request asks the owner to accept.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate, plain. The thumbnails show its upper edge as a flange with two steps and a row of notches at one end of the section, which are not drawn: they are seen too small to read. No Belden document shows the back of the part.

shell.note: estimated - A SHEET BODY, NOT A BOX: the back plate as a well 181.9 deep, the two rows of fingers standing in it, the cover in it across the finger heads, which opens and lifts off. The data sheet says "Steel and Plastic Molded Fingers" and nothing of the plate's construction.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.5, a stand-in; no Belden document states a gauge.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the back plate 1.5 thick, the finger plate to the cover, ten openings 34.0 wide on a 42.5 pitch from 16 to 160 deep with rounded roots, narrowing to a 28.0 neck under the cover's 13.9 return. Read off the thumbnails against the 7.22 in depth; no view of the maker's is orthographic.

weight.note: datasheet - 5.2 lb in the data sheet's Weight row and Variants table, 2.36 kg. The data sheet does not say whether it is a net or a shipping weight; it is stated as the weight.
